component.name: Link All
component.summary: One clipboard, files and notifications across your devices

description.p: Link All brings continuity to every operating system. Your Linux computer works hand in hand with your Android phone, your Windows PC and your Mac, straight over your own network, encrypted end to end. No cloud, no account.

ul.li: Copy on one device and paste on another, with a searchable clipboard history
Send files and whole folders, with live progress and resume
See your phone's notifications and incoming calls on your computer
Browse, preview and download files from your other devices
Pair once by matching a code, or by scanning a QR code

description.p: A new Link All app for Linux: devices, clipboard history, transfers, file browsing, activity and settings, with a tray icon and desktop notifications.
